name: Ideaforge Technology Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2007, ideaForge Technology Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS).[1]
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
The company is the leader in India's UAV market, holding a 50% market share. It was the first to develop VTOL hybrid UAVs and high-altitude drones. It is ranked 3rd globally in dual-use drones (civil and defense) in the 2024 Drone Industry Insights Global Drone Review. [1] [2]

cons: Stock is trading at 3.59 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.65% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 97.3 to 127 days.
Working capital days have increased from 270 days to 403 days
